body: A barreleye fish carries a clear dome over its head.
Its tubular eyes rotate upward to spot prey above.
A goblin shark shoots its jaws forward in an instant.
A vampire squid flips its webbed arms out, exposing tiny spines.
A leafy seadragon vanishes among seaweed with leaflike camouflage.
A giant isopod resembles an armored pill bug.
A Dumbo octopus flaps ear-like fins through the deep.
An anglerfish dangles a glowing lure in darkness.
A blanket octopus unfurls a huge web between its arms.
optional_closing: In the deep, looking strange can mean staying alive.
